'''Aligning the Matrix''' is a [[weave]] from the [[Age of Legends]]. The weave was used to strengthen metal, and was probably the method used for making [[power-wrought]] weapons, the likes which are not found in the present day. [[Moghedien]] tried to teach [[Egwene al'Vere]] the weave, however Moghedien is poorer at Aligning the Matrix than she is at [[Healing]].{{ref/book|6|39}} The weave probably was rediscovered by [[Fager Neald]] while forging.
